title: Sr Product Owner
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

**The Role**
------------

The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

**Your Impact**
---------------

AspenTech is seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Owner to join our AspenTech Performance Engineering organization, which produces software for the simulation and design of energy and chemical processes and facilities.

In this role, you will partner closely with the Agile Team Lead and development team of our Performance Engineering team, to maximize the business value delivered by the team. As the voice of the customer and business, you will own the team backlog, define priorities, and ensure alignment with enterprise objectives. This position requires a strong blend of business acumen, technical understanding, and leadership within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment. You will collaborate with stakeholders to translate high-level business needs into actionable features and user stories, ensuring clarity and measurable outcomes. The Product Owner plays a critical role in guiding the team toward delivering innovative, high value outcomes that drive operational excellence and customer success.

**Your Impact**

* Own and manage the team backlog, ensuring prioritization aligns with business objectives and value delivery.

* Collaborate with Product Management, System Architects, and Agile Team Lead to refine features into well-defined user stories with clear acceptance criteria.

* Act as the primary liaison between stakeholders and the Agile team, promoting transparency and shared understanding of goals.

* Help define and communicate the product vision and roadmap at the team level, ensuring alignment with program and portfolio priorities.

* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies (PI Planning, Iteration Planning, Reviews, Retrospectives, Demos, etc.) to provide context and clarity on priorities.

* Validate delivered functionality against acceptance criteria and business objectives, ensuring high-quality outcomes.

* Foster a culture of customer-centricity, continuous improvement, and collaboration within the team.

* Stay informed on industry trends, customer needs, and emerging technologies to influence product strategy.

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

**Required qualifications and experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or a related field.

* 5+ years of experience across the software product lifecycle (support, development, testing, and product management), including at least 3+ years working in an Agile environment.

* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

* Proven experience working within SAFe or other scaled Agile frameworks.

* Solid understanding of software architectures and modern software delivery practices. (Nice to Have)

* Hands-on experience with AI-based products and their associated data requirements.

* Strong ability to translate complex business needs into clear, actionable technical deliverables.

* Demonstrated ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

* Conversational and written fluency English required

* Preferred:

* SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager certification.

* Strong technical aptitude to engage effectively with development teams.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
**Technical Product Owner**

**Experience:** 8+ Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time / Contract

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced **Technical Product Owner** to lead product strategy, roadmap execution, and value-driven delivery for enterprise applications, digital platforms, and AI-enabled solutions.

The ideal candidate will act as a bridge between **business stakeholders, customers, architects, and engineering teams**, combining strong product ownership skills with hands-on technical understanding across modern web technologies, cloud platforms, APIs, and Generative AI.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prioritize requirements based on business value, customer impact, technical dependencies, and risk.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, UX teams, architects, developers, and QA teams to ensure successful product delivery.
* Lead requirements gathering, solution validation, UAT, process improvement, and Agile ceremonies.
* Define and track product KPIs and ensure alignment between feature delivery, modernization, security, and operational excellence.
* Partner with engineering teams on solution design, integrations, architecture reviews, and platform evolution.

**Product Management & Leadership**

* Strong experience in **Product Ownership and Product Lifecycle Management**.
* Expertise in **Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Lean, and Kanban** methodologies.
* Hands-on experience with:
* Product backlog management
* Roadmap planning
* Release management
* Business analysis
* Requirements gathering
* Stakeholder management
* Cross-functional team leadership
* Ability to translate business requirements into clear technical requirements and actionable user stories.

**AI & Innovation**

* Experience working with **Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Enterprise Copilots, and Intelligent Automation**.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify practical use cases for enterprise products.
* Promote responsible AI adoption with appropriate consideration for **governance, security, privacy, compliance, and risk management**.
* Collaborate with technical teams to integrate AI capabilities into existing and new products.

**Technical CompetenciesEnterprise & Backend Technologies**

* Strong understanding of **.NET Framework, .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, C#**.
* Understanding of **SOLID principles and software design patterns**.
* Experience with **REST APIs, integrations, microservices, distributed systems, and cloud-native architectures**.
* Knowledge of **Entity Framework, SQL Server, data modeling, reporting, analytics, monitoring, and observability**.

* Strong understanding of **Angular, TypeScript, RxJS**.

**Security & Integration**

* Understanding of **OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, Azure AD, JWT**, and secure API integrations.

**Cloud & DevOps**

* Experience with **Microsoft Azure and/or AWS**.
* Understanding of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with **Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, and Git-based development workflows**.
* Understanding of cloud-native application delivery and modernization.

**Tools & Platforms**

* Working knowledge of:
* Generative AI
* Enterprise Copilots
* Intelligent Automation
* Jira
* Confluence
* ServiceNow
* UML
* Solution and technical documentation

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CSM / Certified ScrumMaster
* SAFe certification
* PMP certification
* Microsoft Azure certifications
* Microsoft AI / Generative AI certifications
* Experience delivering **AI-enabled products, digital transformation programs, and application modernization initiatives**.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate combines **strong product ownership and stakeholder management skills with solid technical knowledge**. You should be comfortable working with business leaders as well as architects and engineering teams, translating business objectives into technical solutions and ensuring products deliver measurable business value.

**Key Skills:** Technical Product Owner, Product Management, Product Ownership, Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Roadmap, Backlog Management, .NET, C#, ASP.NET Core, Angular, TypeScript, REST API, Microservices, Azure, AWS, DevOps, CI/CD, Generative AI, LLM, RAG, AI Agents, Enterprise Copilot, Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow.

description:

title: Growth Manager
description:
**About A47**

A47 is looking for a dynamic, data-driven **Growth Manager** to take charge of scaling our D2C business across some of India's most exciting IP-led collections – from ISRO and the Indian Armed Forces to Indian Cinema and Pop Culture.

This isn't just a performance marketing role. We're looking for someone who understands the entire e-commerce growth funnel – from customer acquisition and conversion to profitability and repeat purchases.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a detail-oriented, commercially savvy Merchandiser to manage the end-to-end product lifecycle—from sample development and vendor sourcing to inventory planning and D2C/marketplace assortment. You will bridge our in-house creative team, licensing partners, and manufacturing vendors to bring iconic collections to market on time and within budget.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Revenue & Business Growth:** Drive D2C revenue growth while maintaining healthy contribution margins and marketing efficiency.
* **Performance Marketing:** Plan, execute and optimise campaigns across Meta, Google and other relevant digital platforms.
* **Customer Acquisition & Conversion:** Improve customer acquisition costs, website conversion rates and overall purchase journeys.
* **AOV & Prepaid Growth:** Develop smart campaign strategies, product bundles and offers to increase average order values and prepaid orders.
* **Creative Strategy & Testing:** Build a high-velocity creative testing engine using static creatives, videos, UGC, celebrity endorsements and topical content.
* **Campaign & Drop Management:** Leverage national moments, sporting events, pop-culture trends and new product launches to drive sales and create demand.
* **Funnel & Retention Optimisation:** Identify conversion bottlenecks and work closely with the team to drive repeat purchases and customer lifetime value.
* **Analytics & Reporting:** Own growth dashboards, track key business metrics and translate data into actionable growth strategies.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* 2-4 years of experience in D2C growth, performance marketing or e-commerce, preferably with a consumer brand.
* Strong hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.
* A solid understanding of e-commerce metrics including ROAS, MER, CAC, AOV, CVR and Contribution Margins.
* Proven experience in scaling online revenue while maintaining marketing efficiency and profitability.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn data into actionable decisions.
* A creative mindset with an understanding of content, consumer behaviour and digital trends.

title: Web Analyst
description:
**Job Description**

We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive Tracking & Web Analytics Specialist to manage and optimize the digital data infrastructure across our global e-commerce platforms. This role is responsible for ensuring the accurate capture, processing, and cataloging of online behavioral data to provide robust, accessible metrics for web analytics experts and business stakeholders. The Specialist acts as the bridge between business insight needs and technical tracking implementation, with a strong focus on data quality, privacy compliance, and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

The primary goal of this role is to establish and maintain robust digital tracking to transform raw website activity into continuous performance metrics for e-commerce improvement.

**1. Tracking Setup & Implementation**

* Define, implement, and rigorously test new tracking events, metrics, and dimensions across our e-commerce platforms.
* Serve as the technical liaison between the business/analytics teams and the IT development teams for all tracking implementation projects.
* Maintain the official tracking plan, ensuring it is consistently updated to reflect changes and new features on the website.
* Translate specific data or insight needs from business teams into concrete, defined tracking points and events.

**2. Data Governance & Quality Assurance**

* Safeguard the end-to-end data pipeline, ensuring the digital data quality is monitored daily, and setting the standards for the overall organization.
* Set up tracking implementations in a manner compliant with global privacy regulations, including GDPR.
* Monitor the tracking performance of various channels and websites, taking necessary actions and involving stakeholders to resolve issues.

**3. Consulting & Optimization**

* Act as a critical thinker towards new tracking requests, prioritizing them based on resource availability and anticipated business value.
* Advise business teams on selecting the most appropriate events and conversion metrics for effective tracking and campaign measurement.
* Serve as a web analytics coach across the company, advising and consulting on the operational performance of platforms and tools that involve digital data.

**Required Skills & Technical Expertise**

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

* Web Analytics Tools: Proficiency in setting up, configuring, and debugging tools such as Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Adobe Analytics, or Mixpanel.
* Tag Management Systems: Extensive, hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM) and/or Tealium.
* A/B Testing: Practical experience with A/B and feature experimentation tools like Optimizely, VWO, or Chameleon.
* Programming: Extensive experience implementing "vanilla" Javascript and working with front-end libraries like ReactJS and jQuery for data layer management and custom tagging.
* Debugging: Mastery of technical QA and debugging tools (e.g., browser developer console, network monitoring).

**Preferred Skills & Knowledge**

* Data Querying: Proficiency in SQL.
* Cloud Data Environments: Experience with cloud-based data warehouses like Google BigQuery or other similar platforms (Snowflake, AWS Redshift).
* MarTech Stack: A fundamental understanding of digital and e-commerce programs and technologies across robust MarTech stacks.
* Data Modeling: Knowledge of data analysis tactics, digital tracking implementations, and customer data management.

title: Product Manager
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

**Business Description:**

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the Global Payment Services (GPS), GPS INM Product team as Product Manager – Receivables.

**Job Introduction**

Manage the GPS INM receivables portfolio, encompassing UPI, NACH, Virtual Accounts, Omni Collect and structured B2B reconciliation products, including DART, ARR and third-party offerings. The role covers the end-to-end product lifecycle, from concept, development and enhancement to launch, maintenance and commercialisation. Working under the guidance of the Senior Product Manager, coordinate internal teams and external partners to deliver seamless client onboarding, effective collection and reconciliation solutions, robust supporting processes, sound product governance and a consistent client experience.

**Principal Responsibilities**

* Manage the development, enhancement, launch, maintenance and ongoing performance of UPI, NACH, Virtual Accounts, Omni Collect, DART, ARR and other structured B2B and third-party reconciliation offerings.
* Translate client needs and business requirements into defined product designs, prioritised enhancements and actionable launch plans. Use market insights, competitor benchmarking and client feedback from Sales, Coverage and GPS teams to develop differentiated propositions, maintain a prioritised backlog and incorporate client validation and pilot feedback.
* Evaluate partnerships with acquiring providers, payment platforms and reconciliation solution providers. Coordinate IT, Operations, Client Management, GPS teams and external partners to deliver integrated client collection and reconciliation propositions, with clear ownership, agreed actions and appropriate partner due diligence and governance.
* Define and maintain end-to-end operating and service models covering client onboarding, production service continuity, collections, reconciliation, exception handling and ongoing servicing. Work with Operations and Client Management to document and agree workflows and resolve exceptions within agreed service timelines.
* Coordinate product deployments, enhancements, testing and launch readiness, with documented requirements and stakeholder approvals. Deliver assigned initiatives against agreed milestones and provide concise updates on priorities, progress, risks and decisions, escalating delivery dependencies promptly to the Senior Product Manager.
* Support commercialisation and client adoption through product collateral, sales enablement and ongoing enhancements. Partner with GPS and Coverage teams to convert client opportunities into suitable receivables solutions, tracking progress against agreed plans, product adoption and client usage.
* Ensure alignment with applicable regulatory guidelines and HSBC policies, internal controls and the Group Compliance Policy. Identify product, third-party and operational risks with risk stewards, coordinate controls and approvals, track mitigating actions and report losses appropriately. Support third-party assessments, regulatory reporting and client-issue resolution; monitor relevant collection, reconciliation and applicable partner chargeback/refund metrics; submit credit-risk exceptions and pricing decisions for approval; and ensure timely implementation of audit actions and resolution of regulator-raised issues.

**Role Requirements / Education Qualifications / Certifications / Experience:**

* Graduate or postgraduate qualification, or equivalent, with a university degree and/or relevant training qualifications.
* Demonstrated progressive experience and a proven track record in cash management, receivables and/or payments product development and management, or equivalent relevant experience, including product development, project management, fintech engagement and market- or client-facing banking functions.
* Corporate transaction banking or cash management experience is preferred, but not mandatory. Experience in merchant acquiring, UPI collections, NACH, Virtual Accounts or structured B2B reconciliation is preferred, but not mandatory; familiarity with DART, ARR or third-party reconciliation offerings is beneficial.
* Demonstrated project and programme management experience, including co-creating solutions with IT and internal business partners. Excellent planning, organisation and time-management skills, with the ability to influence decisions and deliver within tight deadlines.
* Ability to develop innovative, flexible solutions addressing client needs and to understand clients’ business models, operating needs and core business fundamentals. Sound business acumen and commercial awareness, including relevant economic, cultural, procedural and regulatory considerations.
* Strong interpersonal, negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective internal and external relationships. A collaborative approach to teamwork, supported by self-motivation and a proactive working style.
* Strong numerical and analytical skills, with the ability to develop well-founded recommendations for decision-making. Familiarity with emerging technologies is preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including clear, compelling presentations. Fluency in English is expected; additional language skills are beneficial.

**Pro-tip : Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.**

**Additional Notes:**

Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Articulates relevant modern trends in IT and presents them to the C-level within the customer when appropriate. Describes portfolio pieces in detail and references their use in other customers. Mentors others within HPE.

Establishes a recurring process to provide feedback to the account team members and the relevant managers. Actively works with relevant managers to provide development opportunities for extended team members.

Fully utilizes the entire set of HPE tools and processes for customer advocacy. Effectively leverages the existing tools, processes and resources to continuously assure a high level of customer satisfaction and loyalty.

The sections below help differentiate between levels to enable consistency.

* Typically 8-12+ years account management experience.

* (Extraordinarily) strong track record of account management and sales performance.

title: Manager, System Software Engineering - Infrastructure Engineering and Automation
description:
NVIDIA has transformed computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years, driven by groundbreaking technology and exceptional people. Today, we’re shaping the next era of computing with AI—from research and model development to deployment and everyday applications.

We are seeking an experienced, technically strong engineering leader to build and lead infrastructure and validation engineering teams supporting NVIDIA’s Local AI and PC gaming R&D. These teams develop the software infrastructure, test automation, and debugging tools that enable reliable validation at scale. They also operate NVIDIA’s largest hardware cluster dedicated to these domains, ensuring lab readiness, hardware health, and system recovery to keep engineering teams productive. In this role, you will define the infrastructure and validation strategy for current and next-generation platforms, including RTX PCs, RTX Spark, DGX Spark, RTX PRO systems, and DGX Station. You will lead the development of scalable automation and reliable infrastructure to validate AI inference frameworks, agents, kernel libraries, and DirectX gaming drivers—helping engineering teams move faster and deliver high-quality products.

  

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Lead and grow infrastructure and validation engineering teams responsible for CI/CD, test development and automation, regression analysis, failure triage and debugging support, and lab operations, including hardware health, maintenance, and recovery.

* Define and drive the team’s technical roadmap, priorities, and delivery commitments across Local AI and PC gaming, balancing long-term infrastructure improvements with day-to-day engineering needs.

* Drive the development and deployment of tests and benchmarks that reflect real-world usage, supported by automation for environment setup, test execution, log collection, and results analysis.

* Build tools that help reproduce failures and analyze logs and system metrics. Partner with engineering teams to identify root causes and resolve functional issues and performance bottlenecks across the hardware and software stack.

* Ensure build systems, CI pipelines, test orchestration, and hardware labs are reliable and scalable. Plan staffing, hardware capacity, schedules, and investments with infrastructure, security, and operations partners.

* Communicate strategy, progress, risks, and technical trade-offs to engineering teams and senior leadership.

Partner with graphics, driver, platform, Local AI, product, and open-source teams to define requirements, align priorities, resolve dependencies, and deliver infrastructure that accelerates engineering productivity.  

  

**What we need to see:**

* Bachelor's or master's degree, in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.

* Min 3 years of exp in management and over all 10+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including substantial system software, platform, runtime, or systems infrastructure development.

* Proven record of managing large, high-performing software teams, setting direction, developing engineers, and delivering results through teams.

* In-depth knowledge of system programming and operating systems concepts, including APIs, processes and threads, concurrency, memory and resource management, and software–hardware interaction.

* Experience designing, debugging, profiling, or optimizing software across system boundaries, using instrumentation and performance data to improve correctness, reliability, and efficiency.

* Experience setting technical strategy and operational goals, leading multi-team engineering programs, and balancing staffing, capacity, schedules, and investments.

Ability to communicate technical decisions to senior stakeholders and align partners across software and hardware disciplines.  



**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Background with graphics software, GPU or device-driver stacks, DirectX, or Windows platform bring-up.

* Experience integrating or debugging local AI inference frameworks such as llama.cpp, Ollama, PyTorch, vLLM, or Windows ML; familiarity with CUDA or GPU programming is a plus.

* Experience building system software, runtimes, developer tools, test frameworks, or benchmark infrastructure used across diverse hardware configurations.

* Experience with system profiling, performance optimization, telemetry, diagnostics, or analysis of CPU and GPU workload behavior.

Contributions to open-source software or experience supporting developer-facing software infrastructure and hardware-backed validation.

Bring your analytical mindset and collaboration skills to a role with strong career growth and mobility across product and payments.

Job Summary

As an Associate, Product Manager at JPMorganChase within the Commercial & Investment Bank, Liquidity and Account Solutions, you will support the ongoing delivery, commercial growth, and product management of Virtual Account Management, a cash management solution that helps clients structure and view account activity across multiple levels. You will focus on data mining and analytical work that supports product reporting objectives and drives client-facing reporting enhancements. You will partner with stakeholders across product, technology, operations, sales, implementation, and client service to support delivery execution, implementation readiness, and issue management. You will contribute to documentation and enablement materials that improve product adoption and consistent execution.

Clients increasingly expect simpler, automated reporting across complex international structures and payment activity. This role supports enhancements that help clients rationalize account structures, centralize operating models, and improve efficiency in account and liquidity management. You will translate performance data and user feedback into insights, requirements, and measurable outcomes, while coordinating with regional partners across a global footprint. You will also support front-office partners throughout the client lifecycle, including inquiry handling and escalation support.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Analyze client usage and performance data to generate insights that inform product priorities, reporting enhancements, and measurable business outcomes.
* Manage defined analytics and reporting initiatives from concept through requirements gathering, delivery coordination, and post-release validation.
* Document clear business requirements and success measures, ensuring traceability from client needs to delivered functionality.
* Coordinate cross-functional delivery activities with technology and operations partners to support timely and quality releases.
* Monitor key performance indicators and trends to identify emerging usage, balance, and revenue patterns and escalate insights to product leadership.
* Support go-to-market readiness by preparing launch materials, enablement content, and follow-ups to validate adoption and product performance.
* Partner with sales coverage, implementation, and client service teams to refine use cases, metrics, and client narratives that support product growth.
* Advise internal stakeholders on solution details to support smooth implementations and effective responses to client inquiries or escalations.
* Maintain product documentation and best practices, sharing updates through established channels and contributing to periodic training.
* Identify risks, issues, and control gaps, track remediation actions, and participate in post-implementation reviews to strengthen product governance.

**Required qualifications, skills and capabilities**

* 3+ years of experience in cash management, liquidity, or treasury-related product management, product delivery, or product implementation within a complex organization.
* Demonstrated experience delivering data mining or analytical initiatives that informed product decisions, client outcomes, or measurable business impact.
* Experience analyzing data and translating findings into stakeholder-ready outputs (for example, written summaries, reporting packs, or dashboards).
* Experience documenting business requirements and coordinating delivery with technology and operations teams.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across sales, implementation, client service, operations, technology, risk, compliance, and legal stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including translating discussions into decisions, actions, risks, and issues.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, track actions to closure, and meet deadlines.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and PowerPoint.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Experience supporting digital cash management channels, client reporting tools, or reporting product enhancements.
* Familiarity with payments and reporting standards (including ISO 20022, MT, and BAI2).
* Experience using reporting and data tools (for example, Business Objects or Microsoft Access).
* Experience building automated reporting solutions (for example, Excel macros or comparable automation).
* Experience operating within a global product team across multiple regions and time zones.
* Experience supporting formal launch readiness routines and post-release performance reviews.

title: Product Manager
description:

Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. **Key Responsibilities**  
As the Product Manager for P&DI for energy sector data products (specifically, areas like solar), you will own the product lifecycle of our offerings and also run program management across the product portfolio. Your responsibilities will be to:

* Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for relevant products, from opportunity discovery and business case through launch, scale-up and lifecycle management.
* Translate utility, C&I and consumer needs into clear problem statements, PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, and prioritise the backlog against business value, effort and risk.

* Run program management across all P&DI products for energy: maintain an integrated plan of milestones, dependencies, risks and resourcing, and drive cross-functional alignment on timelines and scope.
* Set up and run a consistent program governance rhythm, including status reporting, risk and issue escalation, change control and steering reviews with senior leadership.
* Track budgets, vendor and partner deliverables, and compliance with regulatory, security, data privacy and enterprise standards across programs.
* Conduct market, competitor and regulatory research in the energy sector (solar, storage, EV charging, smart metering, demand response, energy analytics) to shape product direction.
* Build reusable product and program playbooks, templates and tools that improve predictability and speed across teams.
* Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, customers and partners, and act as a thought partner who challenges assumptions and adapts priorities as needs change.

Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field from a reputed university. An MBA or advanced degree will be an added advantage.
* 4–6 years of experience in product management, with at least 1–2 years running multi-team programs or projects, preferably in energy, utilities, IoT, cleantech or B2B technology.
* Proven track record of taking a product from concept to launch and scale, including writing PRDs, managing backlogs and working in agile teams.
* Strong program management skills: planning, dependency and risk management, stakeholder governance and delivery tracking across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Good understanding of the energy value chain and technologies such as solar, battery storage, EV charging, smart meters, and energy management or analytics platforms.
* Working knowledge of IoT and data-driven products, including APIs, platform architecture, dashboards and analytics, with the ability to engage credibly with engineering teams.
* Ability to build business cases, pricing models and financial plans, and to define and track product metrics using data (SQL, BI tools or similar).
* Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, MS Project or equivalent, and with product and prototyping tools such as Figma.
* Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.

We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference-makers in our workplace.

No matter what your position, you will have a vital role in safely feeding the world and taking care of our planet.

To learn more visit: www.syngenta.com

 **Job Description**

Role Purpose:

The Digital Product Manager AMEA is responsible and accountable for assigned digital products that support growers across Crop Protection and Seeds in AMEA.

The successful candidate will translate regional strategy and country business needs into a clear grower product vision, prioritized roadmap, and measurable delivery plan. Reporting to the AMEA Digital Strategy and Product management Lead, this person will connect commercial stakeholders, country teams, product squads, and global platform owners to implement solutions, drive adoption, and realize business value across AMEA markets.

Accountabilities:

1. Product Strategy and Lifecycle Ownership

* Own the vision, objectives, and end-to-end roadmap for assigned digital products, aligning grower and commercial needs with AMEA priorities and relevant global product strategies.
* Translate business opportunities into prioritized product requirements, user journeys, release plans, and measurable outcomes.
* Lead product discovery through user research, process analysis, competitive review, and market assessment, with regular validation from growers, customers, and commercial teams.
* Manage the product lifecycle from ideation and business case through build, launch, adoption, optimization, and retirement.
* Balance regional consistency with country-specific requirements, reusing scalable capabilities while addressing material market differences.

2. Commercial Partnership and Business Transformation

* Partner with Marketing, Pricing, Sales, Commercial Operations, Crop Protection, and Seeds leaders to shape product priorities and support regional business transformation.
* Convert commercial processes and pain points into practical digital solutions that improve customer experience, execution quality, speed, and decision-making.
* Support country and regional product launches by coordinating process change, readiness, communication, training, and adoption activities.
* Act as the day-to-day product partner for business stakeholders, connecting long-term strategy with timely and pragmatic delivery decisions.

3. Business Case, Value Realisation and Adoption

* Develop and maintain business cases for new capabilities and major enhancements, defining expected value, investment needs, assumptions, risks, and success measures.
* Prioritize investments based on strategic fit, customer value, commercial impact, delivery feasibility, total cost, and reuse potential across markets.
* Own value-realisation plans and track product adoption, benefits, ROI, and operating performance with Finance, Commercial, and Analytics partners.
* Use performance data and customer feedback to identify adoption barriers, recommend corrective actions, and inform future roadmap decisions.

4. Stakeholder, Team and Delivery Leadership

* Build effective relationships with Country Digital Leads, Commercial Directors, functional leaders, global product owners, IT teams, vendors, and delivery partners.
* Lead or coordinate 2–3 Business Analysts or product team members as assigned, setting clear objectives, responsibilities, development priorities, and quality expectations.
* Facilitate alignment across Marketing, Sales, Finance, Agronomy, Data, IT, Legal, Privacy, and Security to resolve dependencies and unblock delivery.
* Guide agile or squad-based delivery by maintaining a clear backlog, making timely trade-offs, and ensuring acceptance criteria reflect business and user needs.
* Communicate product strategy, roadmap, risks, decisions, and results to regional and country stakeholders using concise evidence-based narratives.

5. Governance, Platforms and Performance

* Define and monitor product KPIs covering customer experience, adoption, process performance, commercial value, reliability, and cost.
* Apply product governance, investment, architecture, data privacy, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements throughout the lifecycle.
* Coordinate implementation and integration with relevant commercial platforms, which may include Salesforce, SAP S/4HANA, DTP, Lynx, Cropwise, analytics, and content or commerce platforms.
* Maintain product health and delivery reporting, escalating material risks early and driving continuous improvement based on evidence.

Knowledge, Experience & Capabilities

Required Experience

* 12+ years of relevant experience in digital product management, commercial transformation, business analysis, or technology-enabled business change, with direct responsibility for product outcomes.
* Commercial domain experience in Marketing, Pricing, Sales, Commercial Operations, CRM, e-commerce, or related customer-facing processes.
* Experience delivering and scaling digital products across multiple markets in a matrixed, multinational organization.
* Demonstrated ability to create business cases, prioritize investments, track benefits, and communicate ROI and product performance to senior stakeholders.
* Practical experience with agile, product-led, or squad-based delivery and the management of roadmaps, backlogs, releases, and cross-functional dependencies.
* Experience leading, coaching, or coordinating small teams, Business Analysts, vendors, or delivery partners.
* Agriculture, Crop Protection, Seeds, FMCG, or another complex commercial sector experience is preferred; cross-cultural experience across AMEA is an advantage.

Knowledge

* Digital product lifecycle practices, including strategy, discovery, user-centred design, delivery, launch, adoption, measurement, iteration, and retirement.
* Commercial value chains and processes across marketing, pricing, sales, customer engagement, product launches, and commercial planning.
* Digital and enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, SAP S/4HANA, DTP, Lynx, Cropwise, CRM, e-commerce, content, data, and analytics solutions.
* Business value measurement, including investment appraisal, benefits tracking, ROI, adoption metrics, and product performance reporting.
* Data privacy, cybersecurity, regulatory, and responsible AI considerations affecting digital product deployment across multiple markets.

Capabilities

* Strategic and commercial thinking: Connects customer and business needs to product choices, while understanding value drivers, trade-offs, and market dynamics.
* Product judgement: Makes practical, timely decisions using evidence; balances user value, business impact, technical feasibility, cost, risk, and speed.
* Influence without authority: Builds alignment across regional, country, global, and cross-functional stakeholders through clear logic, data, and constructive challenge.
* Customer and grower empathy: Uses direct insight to understand needs, behaviours, and adoption barriers, and converts that understanding into product decisions.
* Delivery and people leadership: Creates clarity, holds teams accountable for outcomes, coaches others, and maintains momentum through ambiguity and competing priorities.
* Cross-cultural collaboration: Builds trust across diverse AMEA markets and adapts communication and delivery approaches without losing strategic consistency.

Critical Success Factors & Key Challenges

Critical Success Factors (24-month horizon)

* Assigned product roadmaps are aligned to AMEA and country commercial priorities, with transparent decisions, approved business cases, and clear ownership.
* Priority product launches or major enhancements are delivered with validated user and business value, appropriate quality, and effective market readiness.
* Adoption and value-realisation targets are agreed, measured, and actively managed, with evidence of improved customer experience or commercial process performance.
* Product governance and reporting provide stakeholders with reliable visibility of investment, delivery status, risks, adoption, benefits, and product health.
* Country teams, global platform owners, and product squads work to shared priorities with dependencies and decisions resolved in a timely manner.
* Business Analysts and product team members show measurable growth in product thinking, stakeholder engagement, analysis quality, and delivery discipline.

Key Challenges

* Balancing regional standardization and platform reuse with diverse country processes, customer needs, regulations, and levels of digital maturity.
* Prioritizing limited investment and delivery capacity across competing country, regional, functional, and global demands.
* Driving adoption and sustained behaviour change when the product depends on new commercial processes, data quality, local capability, or customer trust.
* Integrating global and regional platforms while managing legacy systems, technical dependencies, cybersecurity, privacy, and regulatory constraints.
* Maintaining delivery momentum and measurable value while requirements, market conditions, and stakeholder priorities evolve.

 **Qualifications**

Education B.tech/MBA,

12+ years of relevant experience in digital product management, commercial transformation, business analysis, or technology-enabled business change, with direct responsibility for product outcomes.

 **Additional Information**

Innovations

The employee may, as part of the role and through multifunctional teams, participate in the creation and design of innovative solutions, contributing to inventions, designs, product work, know-how, copyrights, software, and other intellectual assets.

title: Senior Product Manager - KYC Platform
description:
Senior Product Manager — KYC Platform
  
  
Build the onboarding backbone that powers every credit product PayU Finance owns.
  
  
ABOUT PAYU FINANCE INDIA
  
  
PayU Finance India Limited is one of India's fastest-growing digital lending businesses, operating at the intersection of payments, credit, and technology. Through our flagship consumer product LazyPay and a rapidly expanding suite of merchant lending solutions, we serve millions of Indians with instant, responsible credit — making financial access simple, fair, and digital-first.
  
  
We are building the credit infrastructure for the next 500 million Indians. As a regulated NBFC backed by Prosus, one of the world's largest technology investors, we combine the agility of a startup with the governance of a regulated financial institution. Our teams solve hard problems in underwriting, platform engineering, compliance, and product — at scale, in real time.
  
  
ABOUT THE ROLE
  
  
As the Senior Product Manager for KYC Platform at PayU Finance, you will own the end-to-end Know Your Customer (KYC) infrastructure that underpins every lending product we operate — LazyPay consumer credit, merchant lending, BNPL, co-lending, and future lines of business. This is a platform role, not a product feature role. You will think in systems: designing scalable, partner-agnostic KYC journeys that can be configured, extended, and reused across business units. You will work closely with Compliance, Legal, Engineering, Data, and external partners including KYC bureaus, video-KYC vendors, DigiLocker, UIDAI, and banking correspondents. You will set the gold standard for compliant, frictionless onboarding at PayU Finance.
  
  
WHAT YOU WILL DO
  
  
**Define and own the KYC Platform roadmap:** design a modular, API-first KYC platform that serves all internal business units as internal consumers — eliminating duplication and enabling faster product launches.
  
**Drive platform thinking:** abstract KYC flows into reusable components (identity verification, liveness, document parsing, de-dup, risk flagging) and define clear platform contracts for product teams to build on.
  
**Lead partner integration strategy:** evaluate, onboard, and manage integrations with KYC vendors (CKYC, video-KYC, DigiLocker, UIDAI, PAN validation, face-match), negotiate SLAs, and own fallback logic.
  
**Translate regulatory requirements into product specs:** work alongside Compliance and Legal to convert RBI, PMLA, and FATF guidelines into product requirements — including re-KYC cycles, audit trail design, and data retention policies.
  
**Build with data:** define KYC funnel metrics, drop-off analytics, and fraud signals. Use data to reduce onboarding friction while maintaining regulatory thresholds. Continuously A/B test and iterate on the onboarding journey.
  
**Enable developer experience:** define clear API specifications, documentation, and sandbox environments so product and engineering teams across PayU Finance can self-serve on KYC without ad-hoc requests.
  
**Plan for scale and longevity:** architect KYC flows that can handle 10x volume, support new product lines (UPI credit, co-lending, embedded finance), and adapt to evolving RBI regulations without re-engineering from scratch.

GOOD TO HAVE

**Knowledge of lending workflows:** loan origination, credit bureau pulls, underwriting triggers
  
Exposure to co-lending or white-label lending platforms
  
Familiarity with PMLA, RBI Master Directions on KYC (2016, as updated), and FATF guidelines
  
Experience with identity fraud detection, liveness check providers, or device intelligence
  
  
WHY PAYU FINANCE?
  
  
Own a platform product that will directly power India's next wave of digital credit — from consumer to merchant to embedded finance
  
Work at the intersection of product, compliance, and engineering in one of India's most complex regulatory environments
  
Build from the ground up — this role has significant greenfield opportunity to set the architecture, not just maintain it
  
Be part of a Prosus-backed, profitable business with the scale of a large company and the decision-making speed of a startup

title: Product Manager - API & Data Management

We're looking for an experienced Product Manager who treats APIs and data as products, with real consumers, roadmaps, service levels and adoption targets. This is a product role that owns priorities and outcomes, not a hands-on developer or data engineering position.

* Set API standards with Enterprise Architecture: design conventions, security, versioning and deprecation
* Launch a developer portal and self-service partner onboarding, and cut the time it takes a partner to go live
* Act as product owner for API delivery on MuleSoft, and help shape our move toward a group-wide integration platform
* Own the canonical data model for customer, policy, product, quote, claim, partner and payment
* Establish master data, data quality, lineage and stewardship with business domain owners
* Rationalize reporting so the business has one trusted source for core metrics
* Build privacy, consent and data residency into every API and data product
* Lead the API & Data pods with our SI partner: epics, acceptance criteria, sprint reviews and sign-off
  

**What skills and experience you’ll bring on this journey:**

* 8+ years in product management, integration, data management or enterprise technology, including 4+ years owning APIs, integration platforms or data products
* A track record shipping an API program with external partner consumers
* Experience defining or governing an enterprise or canonical data model
* Fluency in REST, OpenAPI, event-driven integration, OAuth 2.0 and API gateways; MuleSoft Anypoint or similar
* Strong grounding in data quality, master data, lineage and BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau
* Experience in large transformation programs with multiple partners and regions
* The ability to turn competing asks from many stakeholders into one clear, defensible priority list

**Nice to have**

* Insurance, financial services, or travel and assistance experience
* Familiarity with ACORD or other insurance data standards
* Experience consolidating integration estates onto a shared platform
* Exposure to AWS data services, Snowflake or Databricks
* MuleSoft, SAFe or Scrum Product Owner (CSPO or PSPO) certification
  

**Why you’ll love working with us!**

We value optimism, caring, togetherness, reliability, results-orientation, and forward-thinking.

  

We have more than 3000 employees worldwide. We are a global group of digital specialists, actuaries, marketers, doctors, nurses, case managers, claims specialists, finance experts, customer service and corporate services professionals. We share a global purpose to look after travellers, at every step of their journey.

  

**Job flexibility**. We understand the importance of making sure that work fits into your life, not the other way around. Our hybrid approach ensures you can maintain work-life balance with the flexibility of 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home, after an initial training period.

We’re committed to helping our people thrive through a comprehensive onboarding experience, continuous professional development, and a supportive work environment that empowers growth at every stage of your career.

  

**Take the time you need, for you and your community**. We encourage you to take the time you need when you need it. We offer regular annual and personal leave benefits along with anniversary leave, volunteer leave and a comprehensive paid parental leave scheme.

  

**Diversity and inclusion**. We respect who you are and thoroughly embrace diversity. Wherever life has taken you, we welcome you to bring your whole self to work. Just be you – because that’s exactly who we’re looking for.

* Coverage under group personal accident insurance

* Generous range of paid leave – 21 annual leave days, 6 sick leave days, 12 public holidays

title: Business Analysis Manager, Vice President - Workforce Planning Global Leader
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Are you ready to take on a larger leadership role, guiding teams and influencing strategy in a fast-paced, real-time environment? Our Workforce Planning team is a highly-collaborative inclusive environment where we value relationship-building, strategic thinking, and solution-oriented members.

As a Business Analysis Manager, Vice President on the Real-Time Adherence Team within Workforce Planning, you will serve as the primary business analysis leader connecting call center operations, Workforce Planning partners, and technology/product teams. You will define and drive the Real Time Adherence capability roadmap (process, controls, reporting, and tool enhancements), ensuring solutions improve intraday execution, schedule adherence, exception management, and customer-impacting service performance.

You will lead requirement development from intake through implementation, own the operating routines and governance needed for consistent execution, and provide executive-ready insights on performance drivers and operational risks. You will also act as an escalation point for complex issues impacting intraday performance, including tool disruptions and volume events.

**Job responsibilities**

* Lead cross-functional delivery by partnering with operations leaders, Workforce Planning disciplines, risk/legal/control partners, and technology teams to define priorities, dependencies, and delivery plans.
* Lead and manage a global team in partnership with Domestic/U.S. managers, driving aligned execution, consistent operating practices, accountability, and talent development across regions.
* Lead complex, cross-functional projects using disciplined project management, including clear scope, milestones, resources, dependencies, risks, governance, and executive reporting.
* Champion responsible use of advanced AI, including Microsoft Copilot and large language models (LLMs), to improve analysis, documentation, reporting, decision support, and efficiency.
* Own requirements and solution definition: translate business needs into epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and control requirements; ensure traceability from problem statement to implementation and adoption.
* Provide executive-ready performance insights using service level, volume, AHT, availability, schedule adherence, exceptions, shrinkage/off-phone activity, and overtime drivers to inform decisions and prioritization.
* Perform advanced analysis and root cause work to identify trends, risks, and opportunities (e.g., staffing gaps, workflow constraints, adherence breakdowns); drive corrective action plans with measurable outcomes.
* Support implementation and change management including stakeholder alignment, communications, training inputs, readiness planning, and post-release validation of outcomes.
* Partner with Real Time leaders and teams (managers, analysts, specialists) to ensure solutions are operationally viable, clearly documented, and consistently executed.
* Drive continuous improvement through standard work, process documentation, reporting quality checks, and control strengthening to reduce operational risk and improve scalability.
* Perform additional duties as assigned, aligned to business needs and Workforce Planning priorities.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Advanced Knowledge of call center operations, contact center metrics, and workforce planning / real-time performance practices along with strong working knowledge of workforce management platforms and real-time concepts (schedule adherence, exceptions, intraday actions, etc.).
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence across a matrixed organization and align stakeholders with differing priorities.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to translate complex intraday performance data into clear priorities, requirements, and execution plans.
* Proven experience eliciting and documenting requirements (epics/stories, acceptance criteria, process flows) and driving delivery in an agile or iterative environment.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliverables simultaneously.
* Delivers verbal and written messages clearly and compellingly, summarizes discussions to confirm understanding and alignment.
* Conveys information, ideas, and messages through written words with clarity, conciseness, and professionalism and highly detail oriented, ability to work on multiple projects/tasks simultaneously, manage time, and prioritize to complete a project/task
* Comfortable with a fluid business environment, changing job priorities, and working with people at a variety of levels internally and externally with the ability to work independently and/or in a group
* Strong project management skills with experience leading complex, multi-region initiatives, managing priorities and risks, and delivering measurable outcomes and advanced applied AI skills, including Microsoft Copilot, large language models (LLMs), prompt design, and practical business use cases.
* High proficiency in Microsoft Office products (Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Word, Teams, etc.), Tableau, and business intelligence tools (e.g. Essbase/TM1)

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Minimum six years' experience working in large call center, multi-site, or similar environments
* Minimum six years' experience in processing, forecasting, staffing, scheduling, and/or project management.
* Intellectual curiosity to see through tactical day to day challenges to identify broader strategic challenges and opportunities to drive larger scale improvements. Must have strong bias for day to day execution while maintaining strategic focus
* Proven experience leading multi-team operational transformations, including process standardization, control strengthening, and performance management improvements
* Proven experience applying Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, including generative AI, Microsoft Copilot, and large language models (LLMs), to solve business problems, enhance processes, and improve decision-making. AI/ML model development or optimization experience is preferred.

Morgan and Chase brands. title: Product Manager
description:

description:
**About Cencora**

Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. **Job Details**
===============

**Senior Developer - Power Platform (Power Pages, Power Automate, Model Driven Apps, Canvas Apps, PCF Controls)**

**About the role**

PRISM is the Power Platform solution that runs quoting, resource management, and project management for Cencora's Global Consulting Services business. You'll build and extend it: the model-driven apps consultants and resource managers work in daily, the canvas apps and PCF controls that make the experience usable, and the Power Pages portal that puts quotes and project information in front of clients.

This is a hands-on development role inside the D365 CoE. You'll work alongside our internal functional and technical team and our AMS vendor, and coordinate with Vision25 delivery teams where PRISM touches the global D365 F&O rollout.

**What You'll do**

* Design and build features across the Power Platform stack: model-driven apps, canvas apps, PCF controls, Power Automate flows, business rules, and Dataverse schema. Write PowerFX for canvas apps and formula columns, and HTML, JavaScript, and Liquid for Power Pages.
* Own the quoting, resource management, and project management capability areas from design through hypercare. That means translating user stories into working solutions, sizing work (T-shirt and ROM), and participating in sprint planning, grooming, and demos in Azure DevOps.
* Build and maintain integrations between PRISM, D365 F&O, and other systems using Azure Service Bus, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and Dataverse virtual tables. Design JSON message contracts, handle errors and retries, and instrument with Application Insights so failures are visible before users report them.
* Run ALM for PRISM. Maintain the solution structure and layering, manage the Git repo and branching, and build and operate the Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines that move managed solutions through QA, UAT, and Production. Handle solution upgrades and updates, hotfixes, and feature flags without breaking downstream environments.
* Run Solution Checker and Power Platform ALM best practices as part of the definition of done. Review pull requests from internal and vendor developers and hold them to the same standard.
* Support production. Work incidents and problems with the Incident and Problem Management teams, do root cause analysis, and fix the cause rather than the symptom.
* Document what you build: technical design, integration specs, deployment runbooks, and job aids the support team and end users can actually follow.

**What You Bring**

* 5+ Years experience developing on Power Platform and Dataverse, including at least two production model-driven apps you built or substantially extended.
* Demonstrated work in Power Pages (HTML, JavaScript, Liquid, web templates, table permissions, authentication) and canvas apps (PowerFX, connectors, responsive layout, delegation).
* At least one PCF control you've built and shipped, with TypeScript and React.
* Production integration experience with Azure Service Bus (topics, subscriptions, dead-lettering) and Azure Functions or Logic Apps as the middle layer. You can explain when to use event-driven versus batch and why.
* Hands-on Azure DevOps pipeline development for Power Platform: Power Platform Build Tools or Power Platform CLI, service connections, solution export/import/unpack, environment variables and connection references, and managed solution upgrades.
* Working knowledge of Power Platform ALM: solution layering, unmanaged dev and managed downstream environments, versioning, and how to unwind a bad deployment.
* Comfort in SAFe or Scrum delivery, writing and refining user stories, and demoing to product owners and business SMEs.
* Clear written and spoken communication. You'll explain technical trade-offs to product owners and architects who don't code.

**Nice to hav****e**

* D365 F&O exposure, especially Project Operations, and experience surfacing F&O data in Dataverse through virtual tables or dual-write.
* Professional services domain knowledge: quote-to-project, resource scheduling, utilization, time and expense, revenue recognition.
* Microsoft Fabric or Power BI experience for reporting on Dataverse data.
* Experience in a regulated industry (pharma, healthcare, financial services) where audit trails and data segregation matter.
* Microsoft certifications: PL-400 (Power Platform Developer), PL-600 (Solution Architect), or AZ-204 (Azure Developer).

**How we wor****k**

* Sprints via Azure DevOps or Github
* Code review on every Pull Request
* Nothing goes to Production without passing Solution Checker, automated pipeline deployment, and UAT sign-off
* Vendor and internal developers work off the same backlog and the same standards.

.

Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience required. 2+ years of experience in software engineering, systems engineering, or a related field required. Certification in cloud platforms, programming languages, software development, or equivalent preferred.

title: Product Manager
description:
LotusFlare is a provider of cloud-native SaaS products based in the heart of Silicon Valley. Founded by the team that helped Facebook reach over one billion users, LotusFlare was founded to make affordable mobile communications available to everyone on Earth.

Today, LotusFlare focuses on designing, building, and continuously evolving a digital commerce and monetization platform that delivers valuable outcomes for enterprises. Our platform, Digital Network Operator (DNO) Cloud, is licensed to telecommunications services providers and supports millions of customers globally.

LotusFlare has also designed and built the leading eSIM travel product - Nomad. Nomad provides global travelers with high-speed, affordable data connectivity in over 190 countries. Nomad is available as an iOS or Android app or via getnomad.app.  
  
**Job Description and Responsibilities:**  
You will own the platform that helps our sales and marketing teams bring LotusFlare to life for CSPs, showing what our technology can do in the context of each customer's business. It is also a place to build and try new ideas that are not yet part of the core product, so we can learn what excites the market before we commit to them. You will report to the director of product and lead a team of four engineers.

What success looks like in the first year

* Sales and marketing can set up a tailored demo themselves, with far less engineering time per demo than today.
* Booth and call demos run reliably, with problems found before the client sees them.
* A working experiment track: ideas come in, get tested, and at least some graduate to the core roadmap or are retired with a clear reason.
* The four-person team delivers predictably, and sales and marketing trust the roadmap.

Responsibilities:

Discovery and roadmap: You turn what sales and marketing need into a prioritized roadmap and tickets the engineers can build from.

* Talk regularly with sales, pre-sales and marketing to learn demo pain points, upcoming client needs and conference plans.
* Balance two kinds of demos: live sales-call demos tailored to a specific CSP, and booth demos that must run reliably and with little supervision.
* Check each demo request against current DNO capabilities and decide what belongs on the platform roadmap, what is a one-off, and what is a request to the core product team.
* Write clear requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Create the demo process, user guides and training that drive adoption by non-technical users.

Experimental features: You run the part of the platform where we develop and host features that are not yet part of the core product, and test them before they reach it.

* Set up how experiments are proposed, selected and scoped, and keep them small enough to ship quickly.
* Define up front what each experiment must show, such as client reaction in demos, conference interest or sales feedback.
* Decide, with the evidence, whether an experiment graduates to the core product roadmap, continues, or is retired.
* Hand graduating features to the core product team with the context they need.
* Keep experiments clearly labeled so sales never presents an unreleased feature as available.

Technical partnership and demo quality: You work alongside engineering and do not own architecture decisions alone; you bring the product context and the tradeoffs.

* Work with the engineering lead and backend teams on API integrations and data flows between the platform and DNO systems.
* Define requirements for how AI tools and agents set up demo environments, generate demo data and build demo experiences, so sales can prepare demos with minimal engineering support.
* Take part in architecture discussions, understand the tradeoffs, and help the team make decisions.
* Work with engineering to keep demo environments, data and key journeys stable, with automated tests where they pay off, so every demo is client-ready.

Leading the team and delivery

* Lead a team of four engineers: set priorities, give feedback and support their growth.
* Run sprint planning, backlog refinement and retrospectives, using Scrum or Kanban as fits the team.
* Own delivery of features from requirements through to production release.
* Track dependencies on other teams, flag risks early and keep stakeholders informed of timelines.
* Report progress and results to leadership in plain, non-technical terms.  
    
  **Job Requirements:**  
  4+ years of product management experience, ideally with B2B SaaS or platform products.
* Experience owning features or a product from discovery through delivery.
* Experience working with sales, pre-sales or marketing teams as users or stakeholders.
* Comfortable working daily with engineers and writing clear tickets and acceptance criteria.
* Working knowledge of APIs and system integrations.
* Hands-on use of AI tools in your own work, and the ability to prototype ideas quickly.
* Experience running sprint ceremonies for an engineering team.
* Clear communication with both technical and non-technical audiences, including leadership.
* Experience leading or mentoring people is a plus; if you have not managed engineers before, tell us how you have led without authority.

**Nice to have**

* Telecom or digital BSS domain knowledge.
* Experience building products for internal users.
* Familiarity with AI agents and MCP servers.
* Experience with demo tooling or conference and event demos.  
    
  **Benefits we have for you:**  
  + Competitive salary package
  + Paid lunch (In the office)
  + Private healthcare
  + Yearly bonus
  + Training and workshops
  + Truly flexible working hours
  + Top-of-the-class engineers to learn from and work with  
  **About us:**  
  At LotusFlare, we attract and keep amazing people by offering two key things:  
  + Purposeful Work: Every team member sees how their efforts make a tangible, positive difference for our customers and partners.
  + Growth Opportunities: We provide the chance to develop professionally while mastering cutting-edge practices in cloud-native enterprise software.  
  From the beginning, our mission has been to simplify technology to create better experiences for customers. Using an “experience down” approach, which prioritizes the customer's journey at every stage of development, our Digital Network Operator Cloud empowers communication service providers to achieve valuable business outcomes. DNO Cloud enables communication service providers to innovate freely, reduce operational costs, monetize network assets, engage customers on all digital channels, drive customer acquisition, and increase retention.  
    
  With headquarters in Santa Clara, California, and five major offices worldwide, LotusFlare serves Deutsche Telekom, T-Mobile, A1, Globe Telecom, Liberty Latin America, Singtel, and other leading enterprises around the world.  
    
  Website: www.lotusflare.com  
  LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/lotusflare  
  Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/lifeatlotusflare/
    
  Twitter: https://twitter.com/lotus\_flare

title: Product Owner - Corporate & Individual US Taxation
description:
**Job Title:** Product Owner – Corporate & Individual US Taxation

**Role/Job Summary:**

We are looking for a highly experienced Product Owner with 12+ years of overall experience to own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for our Corporate & Individual US Taxation product suite. The role requires deep expertise in US federal and state tax compliance (individual and corporate/business tax) combined with strong Agile product ownership skills, to translate evolving IRS and state regulations, filing requirements, and tax-season deadlines into scalable, industry-leading tax products that CPA firms, businesses, and individual taxpayers rely on.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Corporate & Individual US Taxation product suite, aligned to IRS/state regulatory changes and business goals.
* Collaborate with tax subject matter experts, CPAs/EAs, compliance, legal, and business stakeholders to translate US federal and state tax regulations (individual, corporate, and partnership) into product features.
* Track IRS regulatory updates, annual tax law changes, state-specific tax rules, and filing form changes (Forms 1040, 1120 , 1120-S, 1065, W-2, 1099, etc.) and ensuretimelyreflection in the product.
* Own, create, andmaintaina well-groomed product backlog of epics, features, and user stories for corporate and individual US tax modules.
* Prioritize the backlog based on business value, IRS/state filing deadlines, tax-season readiness, and customer impact.
* Lead scrum teams by defining sprint goals, reviewing sprint outcomes, and ensuringtimelydelivery of tax product releases well ahead of tax season and statutory deadlines.
* Partner with engineering, QA, and compliance teams tovalidatethe accuracy of tax calculations, forms, and e-filing (IRS Modernized e-File/ MeF , state e-file) before release.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT) with tax practitioners/CPAs and ensure production readiness of new tax rules, forms, and calculation logic each tax year.
* Act as the primary point of contact between business stakeholders, tax experts, customers, and the technology/development team.
* Ensure all product featurescomply withIRS regulations, data privacy/security standards (e.g., IRS Publication 4557 safeguards), and audit requirements.
* Represent the product externally where needed (webinars, firm communications, customer advisory input) and track competitive/market developments in the tax technology space.

**Must-Have Skills:**

* 12+ years of overall experience, includingsignificant experienceas a Product Owner/Product Manager/Business Analyst in a US tax, fintech, or financial compliance product environment.
* Strong working knowledge of US Corporate and Individual Taxation – federal and state individual tax (Form 1040 and schedules), corporate/business tax (Forms 1120, 1120-S, 1065), payroll/information reporting (W-2, 1099), and IRS e-filing ( MeF ) processes.
* In-depth knowledge of Agile/Scrum processes and principles, including backlog management, sprint ceremonies, and release planning.
* Proven ability to translate complex US tax regulations and IRS guidance into clear, actionable product requirements.

* Outstanding communication, presentation, and leadership skills, with the ability tointerface withsenior stakeholders, CPAs/tax experts, and technical teams.
* Sharp analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong attention to detail given the compliance-critical nature of tax products.
* Ability to manage conflicting stakeholder needs and prioritize based on regulatory deadlines and business impact, particularly around peak tax season.
* Hands-on experience with product management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps (ADO), Confluence, Miro, or similar.

**Good-to-Have Skills:**

* CPA, EA (Enrolled Agent), CTC, or equivalent US tax credential .
* Scrum/ SAFe /CSPO certification.
* Prior experience with US tax engines/platforms such as Thomson Reuters (ONESOURCE, GoSystem , UltraTax CS), Wolters Kluwer (CCH Axcess, CCH ProSystem fx ), Intuit (Lacerte, ProSeries , TurboTax), Drake Software, or Vertex.
* Experience with IRS Modernized e-File ( MeF ) schema, XML-based filing standards, and state e-file programs.
* Exposure to AI/ML-driven tax automation or RPA in tax return preparation/review.
* Experience working in a Big 4/national CPA firm, tax technology vendor, or financial services organization.
* Master's in Taxation , JD, or MBA (Finance) is a plus.

**Experience Required:**

12+ Years, with substantial experience specifically in Corporate and/or Individual US Taxation product ownership, tax technology, or financial compliance products.

**Any Other Important Notes:**

* Given the US tax domain focus, candidates should have strong familiarity with the US tax calendar and be available for extended hours/on-call support during peak filing seasons (Jan–Apr and the Sep–Oct extension window).
* Role mayrequireoverlap with US time zones for stakeholder collaboration, depending on team location.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skillsrequiredfor client/stakeholder-facing engagement.
* CPA/EA certification or equivalent US tax credential preferred; Agile/Scrum certification (CSPO, SAFe ) is an added advantage.
* Location, shift timings, and travel requirements to be confirmed by the hiring manager based on project/client needs.
